name: Furnos the Iron Wall
bio: Furnos carries the Iron Wall, an ancient shield known to drive mad any who touched it. Furnos had accepted the same fate, ready to die if he could save his people. Instead, he became one of the most powerful Magmabloods of his generation.

effects.label: Weaken
effects.description: Increase the damage the recipient takes from all attacks by the indicated percentage.

effects.label: Crit DMG Up
effects.description: Increases the recipient's Crit Damage stat by the indicated percentage.

effects.label: Crit Rate Up
effects.description: Increases the recipient's Crit Rate stat by the indicated percentage.

effects.label: Move SPD Up
effects.description: Increases the recipient's Movement Speed by the indicated amount.

effects.label: ATK Down
effects.description: Decreases the recipient's Attack stat by the indicated percentage.

effects.label: Taunt
effects.description: The recipient is forced to attack whoever cast the Taunt debuff on them.The recipient can move freely, but can only use their Combo Attacks.
